test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 13 Dec 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is '**employed**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate word for the third blank is 'employed'.
 
• The given passage is about the creation of superheroes in Indian comics. It mentions various characters and publishers who have contributed to the Indian comic book industry.
 
• The word "**employed**" means to engage the services of someone for a specific job or purpose, often in exchange for payment. In this context, it means that Indrajal comics hired or engaged Aabid Surti who created the character of Bhadur.
 
• By using the word "**employed**", the sentence implies that Aabid Surti was working for Indrajal comics and was paid for his work. This suggests that he was a professional comic book artist or writer who was contracted by the company to create content for their comics.
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 1.**

 

Correct *Passage*:__ *Comics have (1) __produced__ many superheroes. Bantul, the great was (2) __created__ in the year 1965 in the backdrop of the Indo-Pak war. Indrajal comics was set up in 1964 and **(3) __employed__** Aabid Surti, who gave birth to a character called Bhadur in 1976 wearing kurta and jeans. Raj comics too (4) ________ into this sphere with their (5) ________ toons Nagraj, Tiranga and Shakti together called Brahman Rakshak (protectors of the universe).*
